fix_line: Add a minimum-target check for the phone and watch builds to the release checks, with the number kept in one place
title: The release checks print which Android version the app targets but never stop a release that Google Play would refuse
how_often: once a year, when Play raises the bar
expected: The release checks fail early, with a plain message, when the phone or watch build targets an Android version below what Play currently accepts.
what: Before a release, the checks read the Android version the phone app and watch app are built for and only print it. Google Play raises this minimum every August (now Android 16 for phone updates, Android 15 for watch updates). A build below it passes every check here, is published as a release, and is only turned away when it reaches Play.
